_doc: Route scoring windows as data. A route is found by the sha1 (first 12) of the script as run, or by file name. Times are app-clock seconds; a script mark (wait_met / wait_skipped / script_end line=N at=T) is on the script clock, so the scorer adds EDEN_GUEST_START. A 5 s fps line is stamped at the END of its 5 seconds. Definitions transcribed from runs/Vampinity/2026-11-15-t186-control-README.md (Vampinity) and our kokiri-four-stops README; to be confirmed by their owners.

after_field.note: median of the 5 s lines from 70 s after the lowest line in the load to the end of the log; the lowest line is taken within 45 s after the last line of 55 fps or more following the field walk
